messages.content: You decompose authorized security objectives into ordered, grounded, checkable steps. Use only supplied technique identifiers. Return JSON only with a steps array; every step must contain action, technique, and deterministic check fields.

{"objective":"Recover the input-validation logic and document the accepted input using offline static analysis and deterministic replay.","grounding":[{"id":"RE-BINARY-INVENTORY","name":"Inventory binary structure and analysis prerequisites","description":"Record format, architecture, entrypoints, sections, imports, exports, symbols, strings, protections, and analysis blockers before deeper reasoning.","default_checks":["The analyzed artifact hash matches campaign metadata.","Binary format and architecture are recorded.","Expected inventory artifacts exist and parse successfully.","Missing or malformed inputs are reported as incomplete rather than absence."],"prerequisite_techniques":[]},{"id":"RE-STATIC-CALLGRAPH","name":"Map static call relationships around an input surface","description":"Identify entrypoints, callers, callees, indirect-call uncertainty, and data-flow-relevant helpers around a target behavior.","default_checks":["Every claimed call edge has an address or symbol locator.","Unresolved indirect calls are listed explicitly.","The call graph identifies which paths are proven and which remain candidates."],"prerequisite_techniques":["RE-BINARY-INVENTORY"]},{"id":"RE-INPUT-VALIDATION-TRACE","name":"Recover input parsing and validation decisions","description":"Trace input acquisition through parsing, transformations, comparisons, branch decisions, success paths, and rejection paths without assuming semantics from strings alone.","default_checks":["The input source and destination representation are identified.","Every success and rejection branch has a code locator.","Transformations and comparison constants are supported by decompilation or disassembly evidence.","Unknown helper behavior is represented as an unresolved dependency."],"prerequisite_techniques":["RE-BINARY-INVENTORY","RE-STATIC-CALLGRAPH"]}]}
